inputs.text: Photorealistic cinematic 90mm overhead macro, a richly detailed original ancient astronomical chart on aged tan rice paper lying on a dark wooden desk. Dozens of tiny indigo mineral star dots connected by delicate charcoal geometric lines, concentric orbital arcs, one small abstract gate-shaped marker near the upper-right. Irregular paper fibers, worn curled edges, subtle wax stains, pigment granulation, tiny dust. Warm candlelit vignette, cool moon edge light, sharp details, nonlinguistic geometry, empty space for a later red effect, no people, no writing.
